errors.evidence: The description omits the label for the x-axis, which is "测试集" (Test Set).

errors.text_span: 图表中包含四组柱状图，每组代表一种方法
errors.evidence: The chart consists of five groups of bars, where each group corresponds to a test set (Test1 to Test5). Each group contains four bars representing the four methods. The description incorrectly states there are four groups, with each representing a method.

errors.text_span: 黄色（End-to-End）和灰色（LSTM-HMM）较低且接近
errors.evidence: The statement that the yellow (End-to-End) and gray (LSTM-HMM) bars are "close" across all test sets is an over-generalization. While they are close or equal in Test1, Test2, and Test5, there is a noticeable difference in Test3 (approx. 18.5% vs 11.5%) and Test4 (approx. 15.5% vs 12%).
